checked.target: Six-car start grid on the west-end curve (src/sim/world.ts:59-88)
checked.how: Computed the Catmull-Rom near P32/P33/P0 by hand. Start heading is about 95 degrees, so slot 3 (back 24) lands near (-221.9, 57.9), about 4.2 units from the centreline (about 4.8 worst case with seed jitter), under half-width 5.5, so it starts on dirt for any seed. Slots 4-5 follow the centreline at +-1.5. six-car-grid.test.ts AC1 checks dirt and prop clearance on every track, seeds 1-20.

sectorCount = ceil(L/40) gives about 30 sectors of about 39.7 units. The farthest grid slot (back about 36.6) is still in the last sector, so ordered-sector lap counting starts correctly. Cutting across the hairpin pocket skips about 75 units of arc (about 2 sectors) and earns no progress, so there is no shortcut exploit.

checked.target: Hairpin geometry vs AC3 and ribbon fold-over
checked.how: Evaluated the spline on P17->P18: (272.24,-4.28) at u=0.25 and (270.22,-8.81) at u=0.5 give apex radius about 12, easing to about 15. The inner ribbon edge radius is about 6.5 (>0), so no fold-over. Legs are about 25-28 apart centre to centre against the 13 required (width + 2). Bales sit 1.4 off the road edge.

checked.target: Prop placement vs road, grid and ramp (propRows and props in hay-loop.json)
checked.how: Checked all 22 explicit cone trees by hand: each is inside the loop and 10+ units from any road, with no duplicates. Row props sit 6.5-13.5 from the centreline and none lie within the ramp footprint. The 0.52-0.85 trees and 0.86-0.94 tyres end about 12 apart. AC6 asserts d >= half+1 against every centreline sample for every prop.

Collider grid indices are clamped (i1=min(cols-1,..), j0=max(0,..), start=max(0,..)), so a car outside the colliders' bounding box iterates nothing and cannot index out of range. Module scratch (`nearby`, `start`, `clean`, track.ts `seg`) is rewritten before each read, so nothing leaks between races of different car counts or tracks.

The diff adds no src/sim code. Grepped the new tests for Math.random, Date and performance.now: none. G2 shows bends and dust-bowl unchanged at +0.0%, and G3 shows 5 replays matching main. The new track only uses existing data-driven features.

checked.target: Render and HUD size assumptions (scene.ts, render/track.ts, camera.ts, ui/hud.ts)
checked.how: No ground plane (clear colour is the grass), prop cells are 32-unit cells, ground chunks are per 64 rows, and the camera far plane is relative to its distance. Minimap scale min(82/513, 50/170) = 0.16, so the 2:1 outline fits. The Hay Loop screenshots at both sizes show a continuous ribbon, inside bales, outside tyres, a correct minimap and results panel.
